thread:
Jess: quick heads-up before I leave in ~20m — incident-bot just flagged a latency surge and a small error spike on hosted generation. I’m primary right now but need to hand off and lay out mitigations/paging rules.

oncall-bot: Incident #12345 opened — route: /v1/generate-hosted — symptom: p95 latency > 2.2s for 6m, 4% 5xx on embeddings, severity: P2.

Ravi: I can take primary for the next hour. What’s the current impact footprint (customers/regions)?

Jess: Impacting us-east-1 primarily. A few mid-market tenants report timeouts (CS already notified). Error profile is mostly 5xx from downstream redis kv lookups and occasional GPU enqueue timeouts. Rough numbers: 22% increase in p95 gen latency, 4% overall 5xx on embedding route.

Marta: TL;DR runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-blitz — follow the quick triage checklist first. Key steps: check runtime node GPU utilization, check queue lengths, check batching config, try routing to low-latency pool, avoid KV flush until we know cache miss behavior.

Jess: quick checks I ran just now (logs truncated):
```
$ curl -s "https://admin.internal/metrics?service=redwood-runtime&region=us-east-1" | jq '.p95, .gpu_util, .queue_length'
2.25
0.82
48
```
Queue length ~48 in front of model pool gpun1-07, gpu_util ~82%.

Tim: CS update — opened a customer-facing blurb and ETA note: "We are investigating increased latency for generation in US-East; mitigations underway. Next update in 30m." Ava-CS is on the case.

Ravi: Ok. Immediate mitigation plan I’ll run now:
1) Shift routing policy for affected model to low-latency pool (prefer dedicated nodes).
2) Reduce max_batch_size from 32 -> 16 for that route for 15m to reduce tail.
3) If still bad, enable degraded model variant (redwood-v2-small) for non-critical tenants to shed load.

Marta: order of ops is fine. Small notes: do NOT flush KV cache yet — that will spike upstream origin hits and likely worsen latency. If you need to reroute, use the canary rollout flags. Commands: 
```
# route to low-latency pool (canary)
opsctl route apply --route /v1/generate-hosted --pool low-latency-us-east --canary 10%
# reduce batch size
opsctl config set --route /v1/generate-hosted --max_batch_size 16 --duration 15m
```

Jess: Paging/escalation rules for this handoff (write these in the thread so Ravi has them):
- If error rate > 5% for > 10m OR p95 > 3.0s for > 10m -> page SRE lead (Marta) immediately.
- If any GPU node reports gpu_util > 92% or enqueue errors (OOM/timeout) -> page eng-infra oncall.
- If mitigation changes (routing/batch) do not reduce impact within 15m -> escalate to oncall-manager (ops manager) and open a P1 bridge.
- For customer-impacting outages (>= 20% users degraded OR major paying tenant timeouts) -> page on-call manager and CS director (Ava-CS) by phone.

Ravi: acknowledged. Will run the route change canary now, then watch metrics for 10m and report back. If things worsen I’ll call Marta directly.

oncall-bot: Handoff note recorded — Jess -> Ravi. Handoff ETA: Jess out at +20m.

Marta: If you end up enabling degraded model variant, add a short rollout note in the incident so we can revert automatically once load stabilizes. Also tag the commit in the incident with the opsctl diff.

Ravi: executing step 1 (canary routing). Will post results in 5m.

Jess: one more runbook tip — if we see long-tail from embeddings specifically, check prefix caching hit rate: admin page -> /cache/metrics -> look at 'prefix_hit_rate'. If below 60% on the affected pool, that explains downstream pressure.

Tim: logging the CS update for the next customer note: "Mitigation in progress; on-call team has initiated routing changes and will update within 30 minutes."

Ravi: can confirm canary applied 10% to low-latency pool. Immediate metric glance: p95 dropped to 1.9s for canary traffic, overall p95 still 2.1s. Watching queue length and 5xx %.

Jess: thanks. If you need a follow-up handoff after your window, ping in this thread and set the next primary so we avoid coverage gaps.

Marta: final escalation contacts for thread (in runbook too):
- Primary -> Secondary (this thread)
- SRE Lead: Marta (pager + phone)
- Eng Infra oncall: eng-infra-oncall (PagerDuty)
- Ops Manager: oncall-manager (phone)
- CS Director: Ava-CS (phone)

Ravi: noted, watching and will update in 5/10/15 min cadence or sooner if it degrades.

Jess: handing off full context — all tickets/links in the incident. Good luck, team. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigation ongoing. Next automated recap in 30m.
